remaining_bearing_obligations: For fixed 3/2 < sigma < 2, actual affine outputs already have source-independent weighted norm/stability bounds. For continuous sources, normalized first derivatives now have inverse-linear pointwise bounds and L^{2,beta} norm/stability bounds for every beta < 1/2; normalized second derivatives have L^{2,sigma} norm/stability bounds, and actual affine outputs have L^{2,sigma} second derivative norm bounds. Actual first derivatives tend to their forced affine slopes with an O((1+r)^(-1)) bound. Still establish the exact stronger weights or tail asymptotics required by the one-layer source classes, uniformity over varying weight/parameter families, and parameter jets.

The physical local Kummer basis, positive Wronskian and compact-interval uniform bounds are now strictly proved. Derive the actual C→C1 annulus right-inverse bound, uniformity and parameter jets on the compact parameter graph, and extend or select the prescribed matching annulus rigorously.

Instantiate the verified remote generic/log/exceptional free inverses and small Neumann perturbation on the actual finite power-log atom classes with quantitative operator norms and canonical normalization.
Identify the true current-weight Hartree nonlinear source by region and prove the projected exact residual cancellation, parameter-tangent source, and cutoff overlap matching.
Prove every generated source term in the actual Hartree expansion gains at least kappa_prof, without assuming the GeneratedTerm classification.
Only then can prop:one-layer-stage3 and the dependent finite-profile, global matching, and main PDE theorem environments be approved.
